checks: Exact saved root approval, launcher/executor/qualifier/Wiki source seals and approval bindings are required before waiting. Conditional root authority names the exact reviewed executor; disabled template remains false and no readiness is presumed by source preparation.

Qualifier accesses match actual wait_gpu_once.py/check.py receipt fields. Complete source-bound work, terminal hash/cost equality, actual exit/reap/no-cap/no-monitor failure, all O/I/P/G CUDA cases, adopted source/role hashes and whole-Wiki-terminal admission are required. Saved qualifier parent/worker PID and start ticks must be terminal; failure or missing custody prevents start.

Wiki owner accesses match actual OWNER/source, COMPLETE/FAILURE, COLLECT_RELEASE and CHILD_OWNER/CHILD_TERMINAL schemas. Retained analysis failure is accepted only with terminal source-owner and actual recorded child reap/custody when a launch boundary exists; no missing child is invented. A completed analysis must agree with a successful in-cap child.

Waiting keeps CUDA hidden and performs only engineering JSON/source hashes, saved PID/start-tick observations and nvidia-smi metadata. It reads no model, prediction arrays, error-summary outcomes or selected scientific scores, and never chooses a candidate or restart.

The finite 86400-second wait uses remaining-time sleep and final pre-exec deadline checks. Qualifier/Wiki custody and sole physical GPU memory observation are repeated before admission; actual free memory must be at least8589934592 bytes. Source preserves shared-host admission semantics, without reserving resources or claiming future exclusivity.

The generated executor release has the exact v3 schema/source/adoption/budget fields and GPU_memory_admission_confirmed declaration, bound to the actual ADMISSION and conditional approval. There is one os.execve into /usr/bin/python3 with the reviewed executor, unchanged repository and isolated stdlib flags; no fit loop, scheduler, retry, alternate allocation or signal to other jobs is added.

Waiting failure, deadline, interruption, absent authority or failed exec records actual observed prerequisite bindings and failure evidence. EXEC_INTENT is explicitly not success evidence; executor PARENT_OWNER must establish the real handoff. Scientific/training/source/selector/budget work is unchanged.
limits: Source review only: no server, observed current PID/receipt/outcome, numeric payload, model, checkpoint, TEST or source-entry invocation. Actual future prerequisite success and fresh physical memory admission remain unverified.
Root must separately save exact enabled approval and stage/start the launcher. Launch-time memory observation is not future resource exclusivity, runtime success or method-quality evidence.
